card.statement:
Given a generic tableau $T(R)\in\mathcal{B}(T(L))$, a chain in $T(R)$ of length $\ell$ starting in row $d$ is
a subset of the entries of $T(R)$, $C=\{r_{d-i,s^{(d-i)}}\}_{i=0,\ldots, \ell}$, where $1\leq s^{(d-i)}\leq d-i$ are
such that $r_{d-i,s^{(d-i)}}-r_{d-i-1,s^{(d-i-1)}}\in\mathbb{Z}$ for any $i=0,\ldots,\ell-1$
(i.e. $\{(d-i,s^{(d-i)},s^{(d-i-1)})\}_{i=0,\ldots,\ell}$ $\subseteq\Omega(T(R))$). The chain is called maximal if

- sep=0pt

- [(i)] $(d+1,i,s^{(d)})\notin\Omega(T(R))$ for any $1\leq i\leq d+1$,

- [(ii)] $(d-\ell,s^{(d-\ell)},j)\notin\Omega(T(R))$ for any $1\leq j\leq d-\ell-1$.
card.label: Definition 17

paper.title: Irreducible Generic Gelfand-Tsetlin Modules of $\mathfrak{gl}(n)$
paper.abstract: We provide a classification and explicit bases of tableaux of all irreducible generic Gelfand-Tsetlin modules for the Lie algebra $\mathfrak{gl}(n)$.
